subject: Report each server certificate against the config that loaded it (#4664)
reason: The change is confined to src/tls.c and only alters how INFO tls attributes each server certificate's serial/expiry (tls_server_cert_serial, tls_server_alt_cert_serial and their expire-time fields) when dual certificates of different key algorithms are loaded, plus carrying that attribution through the background auto-reload. It affects no data, replication, persistence, or command reply outside the diagnostic INFO tls output. Reaching it needs a TLS-enabled build with a tls-port (an option the provider reserves and the command-sequence experiment refuses to CONFIG SET) and a pair of valid RSA
